sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that there is a level of mitzvos not dependent on human will, whose source is above the level of the Supernal Will, corresponding to the level of Atik.

translations.translation: And behold, this level also exists in mitzvos,
and they are the mitzvos that are not dependent on the will of man149.
And the explanation is that the concept of mitzvos is the drawing down of the Supernal Will,
as per the language of the blessing over mitzvos, "Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us,"
that the mitzvos are a command of the Holy One, blessed be He, to man,
for such is the Supernal Will,
and through the fulfillment of the mitzvah, this sanctifies the person.
And within this itself there are two modes,
positive commandments and negative commandments.
For in positive commandments the drawing down is revealed, unlike negative commandments,
therefore the blessing over mitzvos is only recited over positive commandments,
for a blessing is a matter of drawing down and revelation150.
But even in negative commandments there is a drawing down of the Will,
except it is not in a manner of blessing and revelation,
and it is like the explanation in Torah Or151
regarding the blessing on tefillin of the head,
that the Sephardim and Ashkenazim disagree whether to recite a specific blessing over them,
and the custom of the Sephardim is not to bless, for they hold that it is impossible to draw down that encompassing light through a blessing,
rather it is drawn down by itself152.
And similarly, negative commandments, over which we do not recite a blessing,
for the drawing down is of itself and by itself153.
And on a higher level are the mitzvos that are not at all dependent on the will of man,
like the mitzvah of leadership, "all who flee from honor..."154,
and the mitzvah of forgetfulness.
And the reason they are not at all dependent on the will of man is because their source is above the level of the Supernal Will.
And in the Sefiros it is,
that mitzvos in general are from the level of Arich Anpin,
the Supernal Will,
and mitzvos that are not dependent on the will of man, their source is from the level of Atik,
which is removed and separate from the entire order of Hishtalshelus,
even from the level of Arich Anpin,
as explained at length in Likkutei Torah, end of Parshas Berachah155.
And this is the aspect of "lot" (Goral) in mitzvos,
through which a light is drawn down that is loftier than the light drawn down through ordinary positive and negative commandments.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the aspect of "lot" exists in every Jew, connecting him to the Essence of the Holy One, blessed be He, through the level of Yechidah in the soul.

translations.translation: And similarly, there is an aspect of "lot" in every single Jew.
For as explained above regarding the matter of trials,
that "You have given a banner to those who fear You, to be raised high..." refers to every single Jew,
so too is it regarding the aspect of the lot,
that it exists in every single Jew.
And as our sages said156
"Fortunate are we, how good is our portion and how pleasant is our lot,"
meaning that for every single Jew there exists not only "our portion" but also "our lot,"
through which he is united with the Holy One, blessed be He.
And furthermore,
this level finds expression in a matter of actual deed.
And it is like the explanation in Igeres HaKodesh157
regarding the mitzvah that one was particularly careful with158,
that every single Jew has a particular mitzvah that he must be especially careful with,
and it is literally the aspect of the lot.
And concerning this it is said159
"You support my lot,"
that the aspect of the lot is from You,
His Essence and Being, blessed be He.
And as above, that the aspect of the lot
(in the lower man)
is above his internal powers,
which are the aspect of Hishtalshelus in man,
and above even the encompassing lights relative to the internal ones,
which are the matter of will,
and it is like the level of Atik, which is removed even from the level of Arich Anpin.
And this is "You support my lot,"
which is the level of Yechidah in the soul,
the created spark in which the Creator spark is clothed,
therefore it is called by the name Yechidah
(and this is the name by which it is called160),
for it
(the name "Vav")
is a vessel for the level of Yachid161,
which is the Creator spark,
the essence of every single Jew.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the service of trials and the aspect of the lot, the "right hand" of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is in concealment during exile, is redeemed and revealed.

translations.translation: And this is what the verse continues162
"In order that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me."
For from the fact that it says "in order that" it is understood,
that this verse is a continuation of the previous verse "You have given a banner to those who fear You."
And this means that this "You have given a banner to those who fear You, to be raised high,"
which is the matter of the service of trials,
is in order
(in order that)
that there should be "Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand."
And the explanation is that it is stated in the Midrash163
on the verse164
"He turned back His right hand,"
that it refers to the right hand of the Holy One, blessed be He,
that during the time of exile it is said "He turned back His right hand,"
and at the time of the redemption, that same right hand which is subjugated... "I have redeemed My right hand"...
(and through this the redemption of the right hand of every single Jew is also effected).
And this is the connection to the matter of trials,
for the aspect of the right hand is drawn down through the service of the lot,
and as the Midrash brings there
(regarding this, that at the time of the redemption there will be the redemption of the right hand of the Holy One, blessed be He)
from what is written in Daniel165
"And you, go... and stand for your lot at the end of the right hand."
For the right hand is connected to the lot.
And the explanation of the matter is166,
that it is stated in the Midrash there that [Daniel] asked "the end of days or the end of
the right hand?"
He answered him "the end of
the right hand."
And it is explained in the discourses168
that "right hand" refers to the right hand in Arich Anpin,
and on a higher level,
the level of the right hand that is above Arich Anpin
(which is the matter of Will,
Kesser),
which is Atik, "all is right, there is no left in this Atik"169.
For this level also exists during the time of exile, as it is written170
"The right hand of the Lord is exalted, the right hand of the Lord does valiantly,"
except that during the time of exile it is in a state of concealment, not shining in revelation in the soul of man.
But when a person performs his service from the aspect of the right hand in his soul,
the service from the essence of his soul
(which is above the will,
the close encompassing light),
which is the matter of the lot,
then through this "you will stand for your lot at the end of the right hand,"
for the lot in man draws down the lot above,
"You support my lot" as above,
which is the level of Atik.
And behold, through the right hand,
Atik,
there is also effected "save with Your right hand and answer me,"
for the right hand of "He turned back His right hand," which was subjugated, is redeemed.
And this is the connection between the two concepts in "the end of the right hand,"
the first is the right hand itself,
which is Atik as above,
and the second is "the end of the right hand" which refers to the Sefirah of Malchus171
(therefore it is called "end," a term of conclusion and finality,
for the conclusion and end of the drawing down of the aspect of the right hand is in Malchus172),
for the Sefirah of Malchus is lower than all the Sefiros,
to the extent that "her feet descend"173,
even to a descent into the lowest world, beneath which there is no lower.

And specifically through this service, to redeem "the end of the right hand" from its descent below, there comes to revelation the right hand of "and you will stand for your lot at the end of the right hand,"
Atik.
And it is like what was explained above, that specifically through the service of trials,
which is in the most lowly matters,
and primarily in the trials of the generation of the footsteps of Moshiach,
when the darkness of exile is doubled and redoubled,
then the service from the aspect of Yechidah comes to revelation.
And this is the connection between "You have given a banner to those who fear You, to be raised high" and "in order that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me,"
for through the service of trials, the right hand is redeemed.
